questions.stem: A neonate is born with congenital atresia of the external auditory canal, but the tympanic membrane and middle ear ossicles are structurally normal. Which of the following best explains the embryological basis of this anomaly?

options.label: A
options.text: Failure of recanalization of the ectodermal meatal plug derived from the first pharyngeal cleft

options.label: B
options.text: Defective development of the first and second pharyngeal pouches

options.label: C
options.text: Malformation of the otic vesicle derived from surface ectoderm

options.label: D
options.text: Incomplete fusion of the second pharyngeal arch tubercles
